label: 影片 15
theme: 用專業連接詞清楚表達你的意見
themeEn: The Best Professional Connectors to Explain Your Opinions in English

ex.en: It's simply because you don't have the right connectors in place: words like because, so that, and due to.
ex.zh: 只是因為你沒有準備好對的連接詞：像是 because、so that 和 due to 這些字。

tips.t: Part 5 常考連接詞：because（接子句）vs. because of／due to（接名詞）。

ex.en: These connectors improve your flow and help your ideas to feel structured rather than scattered.
ex.zh: 這些連接詞能讓你說話更流暢，讓你的想法有條理，而不是零散。

tips.t: scattered showers 局部陣雨（氣象報告必考）；本句 structured＝有條理的。

ex.en: They also help you explain your reasoning, which makes your opinion stronger and more engaging.
ex.zh: 它們也能幫你解釋理由，讓你的意見更有力、更吸引人。

tips.t: explain your reasoning 說明你的理由；engaging＝吸引人的。

ex.en: Instead of sounding hesitant or unsure of your own opinions.
ex.zh: 而不是對自己的意見猶豫不決、沒把握。

tips.t: Don't hesitate to contact us. 有任何問題請隨時聯絡我們（商業書信結尾必考）。

ex.en: When you hear someone confidently explain why they believe something, doesn't it make their opinion more persuasive?
ex.zh: 當你聽到有人很有自信地解釋他為什麼相信某件事，是不是讓他的意見更有說服力？

fam: persuade v. 說服（Day 05 滿分單字）

tips.t: a persuasive argument／speech 有說服力的論點／演說。

ex.en: You'll also have a simple structure to make your opinions sound polished and professional in English.
ex.zh: 你也會有一個簡單的架構，讓你的英文意見聽起來精練又專業。

tips.t: a polished presentation 精練的簡報。

ex.en: You can do this by reinforcing your point or inviting further discussion.
ex.zh: 你可以強調你的論點，或邀請對方進一步討論。

tips.t: reinforce a point 強調論點；inviting further discussion＝邀請進一步討論。

ex.en: I believe we should adjust the project timeline since the current deadlines don't give us enough time for quality control.
ex.zh: 我認為我們應該調整專案時程，因為目前的截止期限沒有給我們足夠的時間做品質管理。

tips.t: adjust the project timeline 調整專案時程；quality control 品質管理（職場必考）。

ex.en: Start incorporating them into your conversations and your writing and then once you're comfortable you can add a couple more.
ex.zh: 開始把它們融入你的對話和寫作中，熟練之後再加一兩個。

tips.t: incorporate feedback into the design 把意見納入設計。

ex.en: For that we use words like so, and this helps us to show a consequence or an outcome.
ex.zh: 這時我們用 so 這類的字，它能幫我們表示後果或結果。

tips.t: the outcome of the meeting 會議結果；consequence＝後果（Day 09）。

ex.en: The first is in order to, this is more formal and allows you to emphasize your intention.
ex.zh: 第一個是 in order to，比較正式，能讓你強調你的意圖。

tips.t: emphasize the importance of 強調～的重要性；place emphasis on 著重於～。

ex.en: What pros and cons did we evaluate in order to come to that decision?
ex.zh: 我們評估了哪些優缺點，才做出這個決定？

tips.t: evaluate employee performance 評估員工表現；pros and cons＝優缺點。

ex.en: You might say this new work from home policy is great for those who prefer to work at different times of the day.
ex.zh: 你可以說：這項新的居家工作政策，對喜歡在一天中不同時段工作的人來說很棒。

tips.t: company policy 公司規定；return policy 退貨規定；work-from-home policy 居家工作政策。

ex.en: Also, it helps employees save money on commuting. And here's one more.
ex.zh: 而且，它還能幫員工省下通勤的錢。再一個例子。

tips.t: save money on commuting 省下通勤費；a long commute 通勤時間很長。

ex.en: I love... because... plus...; or: One reason I support... is..., another reason is... And now let's do a quick recap.
ex.zh: I love... because... plus...；或 One reason I support... is..., another reason is...。現在來快速複習一下。

tips.t: Let's do a quick recap. 我們快速複習一下（會議、簡報結尾常用）。

comp.q: 影片教的「表達意見三步驟」是？
comp.a: 說出意見 → 解釋原因 → 用結論或問題收尾
opts: 說出意見 → 解釋原因 → 用結論或問題收尾
先道歉 → 說出意見 → 結束
先問問題 → 說出意見 → 舉三個例子

comp.q: due to 和 because of 後面要接什麼？
comp.a: 名詞（例如 due to traffic）
opts: 名詞（例如 due to traffic）
完整的句子（例如 due to it was raining）

comp.q: 什麼時候適合用 since 表達理由？
comp.a: 理由已經很清楚、很明顯時
opts: 理由已經很清楚、很明顯時

comp.q: so 和 so that 的差別是？
comp.a: so 說的是結果，so that 說的是目的
opts: so 說的是結果，so that 說的是目的

comp.q: on top of that 和 another reason is 通常放在句子哪裡？
